Equipment Lease & Operations

One platform. Every program.

Fully customizable medical trailers, leased with an operational program sized to your mandate. Your clinicians walk into a working clinic — we own every mechanical and logistical detail behind it.

Programs

What runs on our wheels

If it can be delivered in a clinical room, it can usually be delivered on wheels — with the reliability of a purpose-built clinical environment.

Diagnostic Imaging

Mobile MRI, CT and X-ray suites that add imaging capacity where waitlists are longest — capacity that arrives in months, not years.

Built for Clinics

A clinical environment, not a truck with a desk.

Every unit is configured to the program it serves — layouts, power, water and access are designed around the patient visit.

  • Reception and private dressing / consult areas
  • Exam and procedure rooms built to clinical spec
  • Wheelchair lifts and accessible entries
  • Expandable slide-outs for interior space on site
  • Generator + shore power, HVAC, plumbing and holding tanks
  • Graphics-wrapped exteriors for program visibility
Lease + Operate

Scale up, scale down, stay treated.

Leasing means your capital goes to care, not depreciation — and MRA's operational program keeps the unit compliant, maintained and where it needs to be.

  • Custom clinical layouts, delivered ready to treat
  • Operated & supported by MRA — driver, permits, fuel, insurance
  • Semi-annual preventative maintenance + annual DOT inspection
  • On-demand repair so treatment time is never lost
  • Seasonal and multi-year terms
Design My Program
Platforms

Pick the platform. We'll build the program.

Every format we deploy is climate-controlled, self-contained and built for clinical use — sized to your program and your routes.

53' expandable trailersSlide-outs create full clinic floorplans on site — multiple exam rooms, imaging suites, labs and training theatres.
Straight-truck clinicsSingle-vehicle mobile clinics (like the Windsor-Essex OHT unit) — easier siting for urban and community stops.
Coaches & specialty vehiclesBus-format units for screening and outreach tours with high daily patient volumes.
Power & utilitiesOnboard generator + shore power, HVAC, plumbing with holding tanks and filtration — clinic-grade uptime anywhere.
Accessibility built inWheelchair lifts, accessible entries, reception and private consult/dressing areas.
Program graphicsFull-wrap exterior graphics — bilingual where the program calls for it — so the unit markets itself at every stop.
Inside an MRA-built mobile surgical training suite — full OR environment, on wheels
Applications

Four ways organizations use MRA units

Community outreach & mobile clinics

Primary care, testing, screening and health services delivered directly to communities — the core of mobile healthcare.

Medical training

Simulation labs, mobile ORs and hands-on training theatres that bring education to clinicians instead of flying them out.

Roadshow showrooms for medical device and diagnostics companies — put the product in front of every hospital on the route.

Sponsorship & celebration

Health-promotion tours, community events and sponsor activations built on the same reliable clinical platforms.

From Concept to Curb

How a unit gets built

Phase 01

Design

Clinical layout, patient flow, power and plumbing engineered around your program — reviewed with your clinicians before a single panel is cut.

Phase 02

Build & outfit

Fabrication, cabinetry, medical equipment integration, IT/AV and climate systems — in-house, quality-checked.

Phase 03

Wrap & brand

Full exterior graphics and interior finishes that make the unit unmistakably yours.

Phase 04

Deliver & support

Transport, placement, training — then the maintenance program takes over for the life of the unit.
